context: Ren interviews an engineer about performance.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: tech interview; vocabulary (体系/性能/至る/伴う/充分) in natural home.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: この機械の性能は、どうですか?
lines.style: engaged young interviewer voice, soft warm curious focus throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 性能は、十分に高いですよ。
lines.style: measured engineer voice, soft warm informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 開発には、苦労が伴いましたか?
lines.style: curious young interviewer voice, soft warm focus throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 多くの試行錯誤が、伴いました。
lines.en: It was accompanied by much trial and error.
lines.style: clear engineer voice, soft warm informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 完成に至るまで、長かったですか?
lines.en: Was it long to reach completion?
lines.style: engaged young interviewer voice, soft warm focus throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 完成に至るまで、三年かかりました。
lines.en: It took three years to reach completion.
lines.style: measured engineer voice, soft warm informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 設計は、体系的なんですね。
lines.style: thoughtful young interviewer voice, soft warm focus throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 体系を整えれば、性能も安定します。
lines.en: Order the system and performance stabilizes.
lines.style: warm engineer voice, soft warm informative closing clarity throughout
